import os,struct,json
from pathlib import Path
for p in sorted(Path('/Users/itayzrihan/Desktop/Avihay').glob('*.wav')):
 with p.open('rb') as f:
  head=f.read(12); chunks=[]; meta={}
  while True:

   tag,n=struct.unpack('<4sI',h); pos=f.tell(); chunks.append([tag.decode(errors='replace'),n,pos])
   if tag in [b'bext',b'iXML',b'LIST',b'fmt ',b'axml']:
    data=f.read(n)

    else:meta[tag.decode()]=data.decode('utf-8',errors='replace')[:10000]
   f.seek(pos+n+(n%2))
 print(json.dumps({'file':p.name,'bytes':p.stat().st_size,'chunks':chunks,'metadata':meta},ensure_ascii=False))
